name: planprompt gate: ordinary non-plan feedback remains ordinary JSON success and leaves approval pending

source.assertion:
run_hook "$PLAN_PROMPT_HOOK" \
  "$(codex_prompt_input default "$SESSION" 'please explain one risk first' "$CODEX_PROMPT_DEFAULT_TRANSCRIPT")"

assert_after_hook "ordinary non-plan feedback remains ordinary JSON success" \
  [ "$hook_stdout" = '{}' ]

assert_equals "ordinary non-plan feedback leaves approval pending" pending \
  "$(oso-state --session "$SESSION" get plan_approval)"

state_before..local/state/oso-code/{repo}.state:
mode=plan
active_slice=none
verify_green=false
plan_approval=pending
plan_approval_digest=a58ab4a249c56588a8bc6f00bb63e784ab355a30e0d9be3ceecff433bfec0ddc
plan_approval_session=test-session
plan_snapshot_file={home}/.local/state/oso-code/plans/{repo}/presented-a58ab4a249c56588a8bc6f00bb63e784ab355a30e0d9be3ceecff433bfec0ddc.md
plan_current_file={home}/.local/state/oso-code/plans/{repo}/current.md
plan_revision=0
session=test-session
